harness_notes: Rescoped from the full Magnesia regional-unit AOI to Kanalia (a village on the drained Lake Karla basin) for the same reason Valencia was rescoped to Paiporta -- production-representative city-scale runtime, not a 100+ km multi-tile search.

Karla basin itself (the densest flood-polygon cluster, ~19.7 km^2 in one 0.05deg grid cell) has no OSM settlement polygon -- it is farmland/former lakebed, not a town. Kanalia is the nearest actual village and is the harness's best available city-scale anchor for this cluster.

Kanalia resolves as a zero-area OSM Point; boundary.py's own _ensure_areal buffers it to a ~6km-radius disk -- this is the SAME fallback the production pipeline already uses for other point-only cities (e.g. Davao, per agents/satellite/CLAUDE.md Step 10), not a harness-specific approximation.
DEL_MONIT01 is ~1 day post-event-peak -- closest-to-peak reference product found for this activation.

No permanent-water mask available for this AOI in this pass -- Lake Karla itself was historically a real lake (drained mid-20th century, periodically reflooded), so a 'permanent water' vs 'flood' distinction is UNUSUALLY blurry here specifically -- worth flagging prominently in the report, not just the generic caveat.
No Sentinel-2 product exists for this AOI/activation -- this event scores the S1/SAR path only, same as the original emsr692_magnesia.yaml.
